title: TETRA: Improve the description of several CMCE PDU types
description:
- Correct the length of the Call-Time-Out field in D-CALL RESTORE and D-ALERT PDU types
- Add description for D-TX INTERRUPT PDU type
- Add and fix the definition of the type 2 elements in each CMCE PDU types

For reference, see Clauses 14.7.1 and 14.8 of ETSI TS 100 392-2.
